verdict.rationale: LangGraph provides durable execution, checkpointing, and production deployment infrastructure explicitly designed for agents that 'run for extended periods' and resume automatically, which supports autonomous background operation (langgraph-gh-1/6, docs-13). However, this requires developers to build and deploy the graph themselves (via CLI/Agent Server) rather than offering turnkey 'automation' triggers or scheduling, and community feedback notes gaps in production deployment clarity and streaming completeness (langgraph-comm-7, langgraph-comm-13).
